suggestion.scope:
Draft repair scope for trusted asset BENCH-901 (bench) at Riverside Park. Based solely on an unverified public report describing a cracked third seat slat that flexes under load, one exposed bolt, and splintering at the slat edge; no photo was attached. This draft proposes inspection, slat and fastener remediation, and documentation tasks. It is a proposal only: it has not been approved, no contractor or recipient is selected, and no funds are moved. Human review is required before any further action.
Tasks: Conduct on-site inspection of bench BENCH-901 at Riverside Park to verify the reported condition of the third seat slat; Photograph the cracked slat, exposed bolt, and splintered edge before any work begins; Cordon or tag the affected bench pending review if the inspector confirms the reported flex and exposed hardware; Remove and retain the damaged third seat slat for disposal documentation; Install a replacement seat slat of matching material and dimensions; Replace or reinstall the exposed bolt with appropriate fasteners and confirm all seat slat fasteners are seated flush; Sand and deburr the repaired slat edges to address reported splintering; Apply weather-appropriate sealant or finish to the replacement slat if consistent with the bench's existing finish; Remove all work debris and old hardware from the site; Record completion photos, materials used, and labor time in the work log
Required evidence: Geotagged before-work photo of bench BENCH-901 showing overall condition; Close-up photo of the cracked third seat slat prior to removal; Close-up photo of the exposed bolt prior to remediation; On-site inspection note confirming or refuting the reported flex and splintering; Itemized receipt or procurement record for the replacement slat, fasteners, and consumables; Timestamped work log entries covering start, task completion, and site cleanup; Geotagged after-work photos showing the repaired slat and flush fasteners; Disposal or debris-removal confirmation; Reviewer sign-off record from the human review step before any scope acceptance
